summary: Alaska Air Group filed an 8-K reporting the pricing of a $500M 6.5% senior notes offering due 2031 by subsidiary Alaska Airlines, fully guaranteed by the parent, and the incurrence of a $500M incremental term loan facility by loyalty subsidiary AS Mileage Plan IP Ltd., secured on a pari passu basis with existing loyalty notes. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, or strategic review is involved. The filing lacks any event triggering special-situations categories; it merely discloses capital structure adjustments.
